name: PHYBOT
summary:
PHYBOT develops robots through joint design of AI software and physical hardware. Its stated mission is to bring AI into the physical world, treating a robot's body as an integral part of the intelligence system rather than a separate machine controlled afterward.

The company's approach, described as 'Robots for AI,' emphasizes the relationship between a robot's structure and the capabilities its software can learn and execute. Its public positioning centers on native embodied systems and the infrastructure needed for physical AI, with software and hardware developed together to connect digital intelligence with real-world action.
